title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ow6z: Fragment::from_bytes API change broke integration tests
description:
The commit changed `Fragment::from_bytes` from 2 arguments `(data: &[u8], tile: &mut [u8])` to 1 argument `(data: &[u8])` in `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs`, adding the `DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT` constant. The fuzz target at `rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs` was correctly updated, but the integration tests were not:

1. `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs` — 4 call sites still pass `(&wire, &mut tile)` (lines 214, 241, 379, and likely more)
2. `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs` — may also have old call sites (TILE_SIZE usage)

Result: `cargo test -p lichen-schc` produces 4 `E0061` errors ("this function takes 1 argument but 2 arguments were supplied").

Partial migration = broken tests. All test files using the old API must be updated to match the new single-argument signature.
